pr.title: [auto-fix] Restore lowercase dispatch for in-place string conversion
pr.description:
The std::string overload of AsciiStrToLower calls the case-folding helper with ToUpper=true, which explains both reported failures. Change it to false, matching the destination/source overload and preserving the lowercase contract.

Reproduced failing tests:
- `AsciiStrTo.Lower`
